imputability_in_incidents.details: POST /api/incidents accepts imputability field (ME/Mensajero, Cliente, Por definir). GET incidents returns imputability. UI shows imputability select in incident form with default 'Por definir'. Incidents table has IMPUTABILIDAD column with colored badges (red for ME/Mensajero, amber for Cliente, gray for Por definir)

route_type_cdmx_foranea.details: POST /api/journeys accepts route_type, city, max_packages. Default is 'CDMX / Zona Metro'. Foránea routes show city and max_packages. Journeys table has TIPO column with badges (blue for CDMX, violet for Foránea). Journey detail shows route type badge next to provider name

reports_page.details: /reports route accessible for coordinator/executive. Period presets working (7d, 15d, month, prev month, custom). Section toggles working (provider_metrics, driver_metrics, incidents_breakdown). POST /api/reports/generate returns report data with AI insights. POST /api/reports/generate-excel downloads Excel file

sidebar_reportes_link.details: Reportes link visible in sidebar for coordinator role. Navigation to /reports works correctly

dashboard_filtering.details: Dashboard stats API applies assignment filtering. Coordinator with no assignments sees all data. apply_assignment_filter helper function working correctly

layout_route_type_selection.details: Layout page shows route type select in Step 3 (Configurar y Crear). When Foránea selected, city and max_packages fields appear. Route type is passed to POST /api/journeys/from-cosmo

close_route_imputability_summary.details: Close tab shows 'Imputables a ME: X | Imputables al cliente: Y' summary when incidents exist. Summary only appears when journey has incidents

seed_data_creation: Test journeys and incidents created during backend testing with tracking numbers prefixed 'TEST_IMP_', 'TEST_CDMX_', 'TEST_FOR_', 'TEST_DEF_'
